verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. ParPhaseStats::apply_fraction now widens both public u64 timer fields to u128 before summing, so every constructible input avoids debug overflow and release wrapping, and the added boundary test covers u64::MAX combinations while checking finiteness, range, and representative exact ratios. The phase instrumentation remains scoped to the parallel saturation loop, preserves the existing classification path, and is exercised by non-vacuous differential and thread-count-invariance tests. The public surface is feature-gated and documented in the matching inference skill. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect remains in the supplied diff.
